name: Tomato and chorizo pasta
title: Pasta

steps.text: Chop the chorizo, onion and garlic. Kettle on.
Chorizo and onion in a pan, medium heat, 5 min.
Chopped tomatoes and purée in, simmer.
Pasta into boiling salted water (check the packet time).
Drain, stir the pasta through the sauce.

equipment: a big saucepan for the pasta
